seerkang lakaukn tseti nini ini # API Reference

Base URL: `https://leafvault-api.lexa.my.id`

## Response Format

All endpoints return JSON with this structure:

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": { ... }
}
```

Or on error:

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": "Error message"
}
```

## Notes API

### Get Notes by Vault

```http
GET /api/notes/:vaultId
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "uuid",
      "vaultId": "vault-id",
      "encryptedContent": "base64-encrypted-content",
      "createdAt": 1703001234567,
      "updatedAt": 1703001234567
    }
  ]
}
```

### Create/Update Note

```http
POST /api/notes
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "id": "uuid",
  "vaultId": "vault-id",
  "encryptedContent": "base64-encrypted-content",
  "createdAt": 1703001234567,
  "updatedAt": 1703001234567
}
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "id": "uuid",
    "vaultId": "vault-id",
    "encryptedContent": "base64-encrypted-content",
    "createdAt": 1703001234567,
    "updatedAt": 1703001234567
  }
}
```

### Update Note

```http
PUT /api/notes/:id
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "encryptedContent": "base64-encrypted-content",
  "updatedAt": 1703001234567
}
```

### Delete Note

```http
DELETE /api/notes/:id
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": { "deleted": true }
}
```

## Vaults API

### Get Vault

```http
GET /api/vaults/:id
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "id": "vault-id",
    "createdAt": 1703001234567
  }
}
```

### Create Vault

```http
POST /api/vaults
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "id": "vault-id",
  "createdAt": 1703001234567,
  "turnstileToken": "turnstile-response-token"
}
```

**Notes:**
- `turnstileToken` required for new vaults
- Existing vaults don't require token (for sign-in)

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "id": "vault-id",
    "createdAt": 1703001234567
  }
}
```

**Errors:**
- `400` - Missing required field
- `403` - New vault creation disabled
- `403` - Turnstile verification failed

## Share API

### Create Share Link

```http
POST /api/share
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "id": "share-id",
  "encryptedContent": "base64-encrypted-content",
  "expiresIn": 86400000
}
```

**Parameters:**
- `id` - Unique share ID
- `encryptedContent` - Note re-encrypted with share key
- `expiresIn` - Expiration in milliseconds (optional, max 30 days)

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "id": "share-id",
    "expiresAt": 1703087634567
  }
}
```

### Get Shared Note

```http
GET /api/share/:id
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "id": "share-id",
    "encryptedContent": "base64-encrypted-content",
    "createdAt": 1703001234567,
    "expiresAt": 1703087634567,
    "viewCount": 5
  }
}
```

**Errors:**
- `404` - Shared note not found
- `410` - Shared note has expired

### Delete Share Link

```http
DELETE /api/share/:id
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": { "deleted": true }
}
```

## Public Settings API

### Get Public Settings

```http
GET /api/settings/public
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "allowNewVaults": true
  }
}
```

## Admin API

All admin endpoints require JWT authentication:

```http
Authorization: Bearer <jwt-token>
```

### Admin Login

```http
POST /api/admin/login
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "email": "admin@example.com",
  "password": "password"
}
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "token": "jwt-token",
    "email": "admin@example.com"
  }
}
```

### Get All Vaults

```http
GET /api/admin/vaults
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "vault-id",
      "createdAt": 1703001234567,
      "noteCount": 10
    }
  ]
}
```

### Delete Vault

```http
DELETE /api/admin/vaults/:id
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": { "deleted": true }
}
```

### Get Admin Settings

```http
GET /api/admin/settings
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "allowNewVaults": true
  }
}
```

### Update Admin Settings

```http
PUT /api/admin/settings
Authorization: Bearer <token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "allowNewVaults": false
}
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": { "updated": true }
}
```

### Get Statistics

```http
GET /api/admin/stats
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "vaultCount": 100,
    "noteCount": 500,
    "sharedCount": 25
  }
}
```

### Get Shared Notes List

```http
GET /api/admin/shared
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "total": 25,
    "notes": [
      {
        "id": "share-id",
        "createdAt": 1703001234567,
        "expiresAt": 1703087634567,
        "viewCount": 5
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

### Admin Setup (First Time)

```http
POST /api/admin/setup
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "email": "admin@example.com",
  "password": "secure-password"
}
```

**Notes:**
- Only works if admin not yet configured
- Sets up initial admin credentials

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": { "configured": true }
}
```

## Error Codes

| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| 400 | Bad Request - Missing or invalid parameters |
| 401 | Unauthorized - Invalid or missing auth token |
| 403 | Forbidden - Action not allowed |
| 404 | Not Found - Resource doesn't exist |
| 410 | Gone - Resource expired |
| 500 | Internal Server Error |

## Rate Limits

Currently no rate limits enforced. Cloudflare's default protections apply.

## CORS

Allowed origins:
- `https://notes.lexa.my.id`
- `https://leafvault-notes.pages.dev`
- `http://localhost:8080` (development)
